autoPaintTab.unofficialReferenceFilamentSetsBasedOnSu: Unofficial reference filament sets based on supplier color charts. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any manufacturer; names identify the referenced products only.
autoPaintTab.templateHidingDistancesAreEstimatedFromC: Template hiding distances are estimated from color — calibrate before printing. Colors are the supplier's advertised values. Use "Save as new profile" to keep an editable copy.
autoPaintTab.noNewAutoPaintModelWasCreatedThePreview: No new Auto-paint model was created. The preview may still show the previous build.
autoPaintTab.onlyReplacesColorsUsedExclusivelyInTinyE: Only replaces colors used exclusively in tiny, enclosed specks. Thin lines and detail connected to wider regions are kept.
autoPaintTab.hardColorErrorLimitForPreservingAnImageC: Hard color-error limit for preserving an image color as its own printable surface color.
autoPaintTab.requireAUniqueMatchForEveryColor: Require a unique match for every color
autoPaintTab.colorsWithoutAUniqueMatchInsideTheLimitA: Colors without a unique match inside the limit are dropped and merged into preserved colors. Requiring every color rejects the result instead.
autoPaintTab.addAtLeastOneFilamentToGenerateAutoPaint: Add at least one filament to generate auto-paint layers
autoPaintTab.loadAnImageToGenerateAutoPaintLayers: Load an image to generate auto-paint layers
autoPaintTab.tipCalibrateYourFilamentsForBetterAccura: Tip: calibrate your filaments for better accuracy.
autoPaintTab.removingAnyOneFilamentOccurrenceWorsensP: Removing any one filament occurrence worsens preserved colors, coverage, or the selected physical-complexity objective.
autoPaintTab.estimatedReductionInBlendAwareAverageCol: Estimated reduction in blend-aware average color error (ΔE) across the image if this filament is added. Higher is better, but this is a rough estimate, not a confidence rating.
autoPaintTab.recommendedStartingHidingDistanceMmBorro: Recommended starting hiding distance (mm), borrowed from the nearest existing filament by color distance (ΔE).
autoPaintTab.percentageOfImagePixelsWhoseBlendAwareCo: Percentage of image pixels whose blend-aware color error would improve with this filament added.
autoPaintTab.howFarThisColorSitsFromExistingFilaments: How far this color sits from existing filaments in perceptual color space (0–1). Higher means it fills a more distinct gap; lower means it overlaps with colors already covered.
autoPaintTab.currentFilamentSetAlreadyCoversAllImageC: Current filament set already covers all image colors well.
autoPaintTab.templatesAreReadOnlyUseSaveAsNewProfile: Templates are read-only — use Save as new profile
autoPaintTab.everyCandidateInTheApplicableExactSearch: Every candidate in the applicable exact search space was compared.
autoPaintTab.heuristicSearchResultABetterCombinedOrde: Heuristic search result; a better combined order may still exist.
autoPaintTab.someSourceColorsHadNoDistinctPrintableMa: Some source colors had no distinct printable match inside the hard limit and were merged into preserved colors.
autoPaintTab.baseModelRanksChoices: Base model already ranks these choices
autoPaintTab.exactSearchEstimate: Exact base order will score about {{orders}} base orders before repeat refinement.
autoPaintTab.compressedZone: Compressed to fit Max Height — ideal thickness {{thickness}} mm
